subject: Learning Methods
title: Jet Lag and Social Jet Lag
description: A quick win: understand Jet Lag and Social Jet Lag.

hook.text: Sleeping until noon on weekends and waking at 7 AM on Monday creates social jet lag.

buildup.text: Social jet lag means your social schedule conflicts with your biological clock. It affects an estimated 87 % of adults.

discovery.text: The Monday morning cognitive deficit is partly social jet lag. Your clock still thinks it's 9 AM when school starts.

twist.text: Consistent wake times are more important than consistent bedtimes. Waking simultaneously daily keeps your clock locked.

climax.text: Jet Lag and Social Jet Lag matters because durable learning depends on method, not just effort.

punchline.text: Same wake time. Every day. Your brain hates weekend jet lag.

quiz.question: What is social jet lag?
options: Tiredness from socializing too much on weekends
A conflict between your social schedule and biological clock
The fatigue of adjusting to daylight saving time
